turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty. The gravity of the situation is now clear. If I may, I suggest we proceed with caution and consider all angles to ensure the matter is resolved discreetly and effectively.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty. The first step is to understand the precise nature of the issue you wish to resolve. Kindly provide me with the details of the matter involving the House of Ormstein.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Ah, yes, Mr. Holmes. The issue at hand involves my former fiancée, Countess Gina de Coupage, and a compromising photograph. It is imperative that this document does not fall into the wrong hands, as it could lead to a political scandal of monumental proportions.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see. May I ask to examine this photograph to better understand the scope of the threat it poses?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Of course, Mr. Holmes. The photograph is in my possession and I shall deliver it to you at your convenience. However, I must stress the utmost secrecy regarding this matter.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. I shall require the photograph at my residence this evening. In the meantime, I will need to know all the details of your interactions with Countess Gina and the circumstances surrounding the photograph.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I understand, Mr. Holmes. I shall provide you with all the necessary information this evening. And rest assured, I trust your discretion implicitly.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Excellent, Your Majesty. Now, if you will excuse me, I must prepare for our meeting later this evening. Dr. Watson, kindly see our visitor out.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Thank you, Dr. Watson. I shall await your company at Mr. Holmes' residence this evening. Until then, I must return to my duties and ensure that no one suspects my involvement in this delicate matter.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Certainly, Your Majesty. I will ensure that everything is ready for your arrival this evening. Good day to you.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall take my leave now, Dr. Watson. And please, keep our conversation today under the strictest of confidences. Good day.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Of course, Your Majesty. Your secrecy is safe with me.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Dr. Watson, I am counting on your discretion. Until we meet again, farewell.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Goodbye, Your Majesty. I shall inform Mr. Holmes of our visitor as soon as he returns.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I trust in your wisdom, Dr. Watson. Until our paths cross again, may you be guided by the stars.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I shall certainly keep your visit and words to myself, Your Majesty. May your concerns be resolved swiftly.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The weight of my kingdom's future lies upon my shoulders, Dr. Watson. I must take my leave now.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I understand the gravity of your situation and wish you the best of luck.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The fate of Bohemia may well rest in the hands of a British detective and his loyal friend. Farewell, gentlemen.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty, the complexities of your situation shall be given the utmost attention. I trust that our methods will prove effective.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
